title: footage_index
description: Shot-level text index of one video. SHARED CONTRACT: emitted identically by Path A (El-Video, local VLM) and Path B (elvideo-gemini, Gemini-native). Changing this shape is a two-repo change - log it in state/decisions-log.md and sync manually. See docs/schema.md.

video.description: ffprobe output, uninterpreted. Produced by elvideo/index/probe.py.

path.description: Path to the source video, as given on the CLI.

fps.description: Container frame rate. NOT the Gemini sampling rate - see index_meta.sample_fps.

index_meta.description: How this index was produced. Must reflect what actually ran, not the defaults - this is what makes two indexes of the same footage comparable.

path_variant.description: The A/B discriminator. This repo always emits 'gemini'.

model.description: Understanding model that produced the captions. Path B pins 'gemini-3.5-flash'; Path A puts its local model name here.

media_resolution.description: Gemini media resolution. Path B uses 'low' (66 tok/frame, not 258).

sample_fps.description: Frames per second fed to the understanding model. Path B default 0.5; per-video knob, record the value actually used.

shots.description: One entry per shot boundary, ordered by t_start. FULL index, not top-N: 'best moments' is a filter on is_candidate / a sort on editorial_score.

t_start.description: Shot start, seconds. Frame-accurate, from PySceneDetect. NEVER from the understanding model - its timestamps are second-granular.

t_end.description: Shot end, seconds. Frame-accurate, from PySceneDetect.

transcript.description: Words falling inside [t_start, t_end), joined. Empty string when silent - not null.

caption.description: What is visually happening in the shot. From the understanding model.

editorial_score.description: How good a moment, 0-1. Path B's edge. Path A may leave this null - that gap IS the A/B signal.

moment_reason.description: Why that editorial_score. Path B's edge. Path A may leave this null.

is_candidate.description: Flagged good-moment. Derived view over editorial_score, not a model output.

tags.description: Free-form lowercase tags from the understanding model.

quality.description: OpenCV Laplacian + exposure, 0-1. Deterministic, no LLM involved.

embedding.description: RESERVED - stays null in v1. No code computes it. Exists so Phase-2 cross-video search is not a schema break.

words.description: Flat word-level timing for the whole video, not nested under shots. Drives precise cuts and filler removal, and is what words_in_range() slices per shot. Keys are short because there are thousands per video.
